f-plan-complete: On time, with every field filled in, earns all 10 points.
f-out-real: Output is real, finished for this sprint, and checkable by the course.
f-out-checkable: Output is real, finished for this sprint, and checkable by the course.
f-out-my-part: Your plan says which part of it is yours, and your Output is graded on that part, with the team's result as context.
f-out-learn-proof: Studying alone leaves nothing to check, so every Learn item ends in proof.
f-out-waiting: Record what you were waiting on, when you asked, and what you did meanwhile, and that work is graded as output.
f-out-needs-yes: For these goals, Output is graded on the asks you made and can show: who you asked, when, what you asked for, and what they said.
f-out-difficulty: Read against your plan as it stands at the end, and, from Sprint 2 on, weighed by how hard the work was for you
f-rev-committed: Report committed, with your retro answering all six questions and responding to something specific in the report
f-rev-retro: Report committed, with your retro answering all six questions and responding to something specific in the report
f-demo-working: 2 to 3 minutes on Loom showing your work running, with real or clearly labeled sample content, viewable by Professor Murff
f-demo-not-loom: A demo on Google Drive, YouTube, or an uploaded file scores 0.
f-demo-unopenable: A video Professor Murff cannot open is not graded until it is shared.
f-demo-length: From Sprint 2, each started 30 seconds past 3:30 costs 1 point (3:31 to 4:00 is minus 1, 4:01 to 4:30 minus 2, and so on).
late: Canvas applies the late penalty: 10% per day, up to 9 days.
